description: Media Monitoring: get_unlinked_mentions_report's candidates filtered to known social/forum/news platform domains, optionally merged with the citation-platform breakdown from a Prompt Explorer scan you already ran for the same brand. Same cost profile as `get_unlinked_mentions_report`, which this calls internally — no AI-gateway spend, even when `citations` is supplied (that data is only classified here, never fetched). NOT a real-time media-monitoring product: no social-platform API polling, no forum-API crawling, no news-aggregator feed — `scopeNote` states this on every `analysed` response. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first, same as `get_unlinked_mentions_report`. `aiCitationPlatforms: null` means no `citations` were supplied — distinct from an empty array, which would mean a scan cited nothing on a known platform.

brand.description: Brand name or bare domain to search for as a SERP QUERY (not a URL to fetch).

citations.description: Citations from an ALREADY-RUN Prompt Explorer scan for this brand (map its `citations` to {url, domain}). Never fetched here — omitting it leaves `aiCitationPlatforms: null`.

languageCode.description: Language code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 'en'.

locationCode.description: Numeric location code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 2840 (United States).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

trackedDomain.description: Bare domain each result page is checked for a link to, e.g. 'acme.com'.

name: get_media_monitoring_report
